tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_0x02_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verify that a binary value with subtype 0x02 round-trips correctly through BSON serialization and deserialization.

tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_other_subtypes_unaffected
tests.intent: Verify that binary values with subtypes other than 0x02 continue to serialize and deserialize normally.

tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_0x02_reject_missing_inner_length
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects subtype 0x02 binary payload lacking the inner int32 length.

tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_0x02_reject_mismatched_inner_length
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects subtype 0x02 binary payload where inner length does not match outer length.

tests.name: bson_document_size_too_small
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects BSON documents with a declared size less than 5 bytes.

tests.name: bson_embedded_document_size_exceeds_parent
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects embedded documents whose declared size exceeds the parent document boundaries.

tests.name: bson_element_size_fits_content
tests.intent: Verify that valid nested BSON documents are successfully parsed without size errors.

tests.name: bson_element_header_fits_declared_size
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects elements that lack space for name terminator and document terminator within declared size.

tests.name: bson_binary_scalar_reservation_skips_subtype_0x02
tests.intent: Verify scalar writing fast-path logic declines subtype 0x02 appropriately (exercised via to_bson).

tests.name: bson_binary_zero_length_subtype_0x02
tests.intent: Verify zero-length binary data with subtype 0x02 correctly serializes and deserializes.

tests.name: bson_binary_uuid_md5_subtypes
tests.intent: Verify binary values with UUID (0x04) or MD5 (0x03) subtypes handle correctly alongside old binary subtype.

tests.name: bson_multiple_binary_fields_mixed_subtypes
tests.intent: Verify documents containing both old binary (0x02) and standard binary (0x00) serialize and deserialize correctly.

tests.name: bson_sax_parse_valid_document
tests.intent: Verify sax_parse correctly processes a valid BSON document under the updated size checks.

tests.name: bson_large_binary_subtype_0x02
tests.intent: Verify large binary data with subtype 0x02 correctly serializes and deserializes its inner length.

tests.name: bson_document_size_less_than_five_bytes_edge
tests.intent: Verify boundary check rejecting BSON document size exactly equal to 4.

tests.name: bson_document_size_zero
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects BSON document with declared size zero.

tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_0x02_negative_inner_length_check
tests.intent: Verify that from_bson rejects subtype 0x02 binary payload with an invalid negative inner length representation.

tests.name: bson_nested_objects_valid_sizes
tests.intent: Verify multiple levels of properly sized nested BSON documents parse correctly.

tests.name: bson_binary_subtype_0x02_exact_length_match
tests.intent: Verify exact match condition between outer length and inner length for subtype 0x02.

tests.name: bson_empty_document_valid
tests.intent: Verify an empty BSON document (size 5, just terminator) parses successfully.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise document_end calculation without overflow when size approaches numeric limits (executing line 388).

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise get_number failure inside get_bson_old_binary by truncating input stream while reading the inner int32 length (executing line 644).

tests.intent: Directly invoke bson_document_size_error via custom SAX parser parsing an invalidly sized BSON document (executing line 4468).

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify that container_frame end_position and frame fields are populated and successfully enforce embedded document boundary limits.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Trigger bson_document_size_error when an element's type byte and key leave no room for terminators within the container's end_position.
